Markets.title: iPhone Duo internal display break: Are iPhone Duo displays too fragile? Users report alarming cracks near hinge
Markets.summary: Users of the new iPhone Duo model are reporting alarming inner display cracks near the hinge after minimal use. Apple is currently investigating the reported cases to determine if a manufacturing issue is responsible.

Markets.title: US Markets Today: Dow ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed meet
Markets.summary: US stocks fell sharply, with the Dow dropping 1.25%, as ongoing doubts about artificial intelligence weighed on the market. Investors grew cautious ahead of upcoming earnings reports from major tech companies and next week's Federal Reserve meeting.

Markets.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
Markets.summary: Tata Motors reported a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue from operations rose 42% to ₹23,930 crore, driven by increased demand from higher fleet utilization and industrial activity.

Markets.title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
Markets.summary: BofA Global Research estimates that global data center spending will reach $1 trillion in 2026 before more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028. This rapid infrastructure expansion is driven by the surging demand for artificial intelligence services.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose following a previous drop, while the 10-year yield remained below 5% due to ongoing investor caution regarding AI. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation continued to influence bond markets as expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike weakened.

Markets.title: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
Markets.summary: EAAA India Alternatives raised about Rs 360 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering. The IPO, which consists entirely of an offer for sale, opens for public subscription on October 26.

Geo-Political.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has condemned a deadly shooting near Paris that killed one person and wounded five others as a racist terrorist attack. The suspected gunman has been apprehended by authorities.

Geo-Political.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen opened fire at a church funeral in Jordan's Karak governorate, killing seven people and injuring thirty-four others. Authorities have launched a manhunt to find the attackers.

Geo-Political.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
Geo-Political.summary: Former Ukrainian prisoners report that a recently freed US citizen was subjected to torture, beatings, and sexual humiliation by Russian guards while detained. These fellow inmates stated they personally witnessed the abuse during the American's imprisonment in a Russian jail.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli forces started demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Palestinian gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers at a West Bank checkpoint on Friday morning. In response to the fatal shooting, military personnel initiated the destruction of structures in the area.

Geo-Political.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
Geo-Political.summary: The White House stated that Melania Trump successfully brokered a truce for the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky. Residents in the city had been reduced to eating garden weeds in order to survive.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
Geo-Political.summary: Argentine authorities have dropped a fraud investigation into President Javier Milei. The probe was launched after a cryptocurrency crashed following Milei's deletion of a promotional social media post about it.

AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI-driven traffic compared to traditional search engine optimization.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: Construction is advancing on the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line, which will feature 16 tunnels. India is expanding its domestic manufacturing capabilities for tunnel boring machines to support this Himalayan connectivity project.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, higher new orders, and lower inflation. However, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent of earners is insufficient for resolving income inequality. How governments spend public money is just as crucial for achieving true economic justice.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. This recovery was driven by refiners purchasing spot cargoes as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to balance inflation control without harming economic activity.

India.title: CBI Arrests Two ED Officials In Rs 5 Lakh Bribery Case
India.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation arrested two Enforcement Directorate officials in a bribery case involving 5 lakh rupees. The officials allegedly demanded and accepted the money to favor the complainant's father in an ongoing case.

India.title: Gangster Himanshu Bhau, Wanted In India For Multiple Murders, Arrested In US
India.summary: Himanshu Bhau, a gangster wanted by Indian police for multiple murders, kidnappings, and extortions, has been arrested in the United States. Bhau was on the most-wanted lists for both the Haryana and Delhi police departments and is a rival of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi.

India.title: 5 Killed In Explosion At House Storing Firecrackers In Bihar
India.summary: An explosion at a house storing firecrackers in Bihar resulted in five deaths. A Forensic Science Laboratory team is currently searching the property after the fire was extinguished.

India.title: 14 Indians Safe After Boat Got Involved In Incident Off Yemen Coast: Embassy
India.summary: The Indian embassy stated that 14 Indian nationals are safe following a boat incident off the coast of Yemen. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal shared this update during a media briefing, addressing reports that Houthis assisted in rescuing the individuals.

India.title: College Student Accuses TVK Worker Of Sexual Assault, Then A U-turn
India.summary: A college student accused a TVK party worker of sexual assault before retracting her statement. DMK MP Kanimozhi Karunanidhi subsequently questioned Chief Minister Vijay regarding the disciplinary actions he would take against the accused functionary.

India.title: IndiGo Extends Saudi Flight Cancellations Till October 27 Amid Houthi Attacks
India.summary: IndiGo has extended the cancellation of its flights to Saudi Arabia through October 27. This decision is a response to ongoing drone and missile attacks by Yemen's Houthi rebels targeting Saudi infrastructure.

General.title: Storm Austen brings power cuts and travel disruption as more wind and rain forecast
General.summary: Storm Austen has caused power cuts and travel disruption with strong winds and heavy rain. A second system, Storm Boelo, is forecast to bring more severe weather to Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England on Saturday.

General.title: Watch: Trees ripped up as Storm Austen batters Britain
General.summary: Storm Austen brought powerful gusts to Jersey and southern England as the first named storm of the season. The severe weather disrupted travel by knocking down trees that blocked local roads and railway lines.
